scripts.test:prepare: npm run build && npm run build:test
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:prepare && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs unit
scripts.test:unit:explain: npm run test:prepare && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs unit --explain
scripts.test:integration:fake: npm run test:prepare && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs integration:fake
scripts.test:integration:fake:explain: npm run test:prepare && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs integration:fake --explain
scripts.test:integration:real: npm run test:prepare && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs integration:real
scripts.test:integration:real:explain: npm run test:prepare && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs integration:real --explain
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration:fake
scripts.test:ci: npm run test && npm run test:integration:real
